Package com.eloview.sdk.networkManager

Class ESTConfig

java.lang.Object
com.eloview.sdk.networkManager.ESTConfig
All Implemented Interfaces:
android.os.Parcelable
public class ESTConfig extends Object implements android.os.Parcelable
EstConfig class contains the certificate details, which is required for EST Certificate to installation.

It consist below information.
For e.g.

  • url : 192.168.2.1
  • port : 8085
  • alias : test
  • estUsername : username
  • estPassword : password
  • certificateFilePath : /sdcard/certificate.pem
